verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is documented only as a hosted payments service that customers reach through its APIs, SDKs, plugins and dashboard. Nothing in the evidence describes a self-hostable or on-premises deployment of the core product. Self-hosting is a fair question for payment platforms, since open-source payment gateways exist, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
